explication: WebLLM is a browser-based LLM inference engine. An application creates and loads a model through the engine, then submits chat, completion, or embedding requests and receives results, optionally as a stream. The engine coordinates model assets, tokenization, and inference; worker variants move engine work off the main thread. The README also documents structured generation, model customization, and several browser cache backends. Resumable generation and storage links reflect the sampled engine and session code; other unsampled subsystem wiring is omitted.
